cells.tense: You are here at the moment of choosing, and what you choose shows that you are here.
cells.act: trace the pattern across the last few times
cells.ask: Set your recent decisions side by side — three or four of them — and sketch what was actually running under each. Alter nothing. The shape that repeats is the thing to notice.
cells.core:
You can pick a direction, and the picking comes from what is actually here, not from proving anything to anyone. When you go this way and not that, the choice holds without strain. What you are becoming is already visible in the way you aim your attention, and no one had to be told. Not achievement. Just you, with the pen in your hand.

What deepens it is seeing how the thing works. Lay three recent choices side by side and trace what was operating underneath each — the mechanism, not the story. The same shape is probably doing the work three times. Keep what you draw. It tells you what you are, which outlasts what you decided.
cells.sheetLine: What you are shows in how you choose.
cells.verb: to choose this and let what you are show in it
cells.place: where direction is picked and the first step is taken

cells.tense: You are reaching past the choosing, and the direction cannot be lived yet.
cells.act: leave it undecided a while longer
cells.ask: Hold a decision you are bracing to make open three more days. No researching, no rehearsing. Three days of not closing it. What the waiting feels like is the information.
cells.core:
The aiming has gotten out beyond the moment it lands in. You are choosing from the far edge, where everything has to be settled before it is here, and the force of it lands on people who only needed the next step. The direction is good; the timing is louder than the direction. What you are becoming does not need defending — it needs to arrive.

So try the opposite for a week. Take an open decision and do not close it. Keep more than one door standing where it is. The discomfort of the undecided shows you which part of the reach was bracing and which part was actually needed. Picking your direction stays yours; you are only letting the moment catch up.
cells.sheetLine: You are choosing from further out than the moment you are in.
cells.verb: to choose this and let what you are show in it

cells.tense: You are standing at a door you have already walked through and calling it someone else's.
cells.act: choose this, not that, and mean it
cells.ask: Decide one thing you already settled, and settle it again on purpose, in your own words — this way, not that way. Say nothing to anyone. Then give one direction your first step.
cells.core:
Something in you is already shining and you are dimming it. What you have set in motion is running — direction picked, first step taken — and when it comes up you reach for a smaller word: luck, timing, the way things went. The power to decide and mean it is not used up. It is being spent on not spending itself.

Charge it before showing anyone. Take a choice already made and re-decide it, deliberately, in your own language. Then keep going: give your attention to one thing, take the first step, and refuse the second so the first can have you.
cells.sheetLine: You are already choosing. Say it as yours.
cells.verb: to choose this and let what you are show in it
cells.place: where direction is picked and the first step is taken

cells.tense: You are steering with the pen down, in a room that has been growing around the direction you already set.
cells.act: meet what is arriving as it arrives
cells.ask: Watch for what shows up in your plan this week that you would normally walk past as old news. Meet it as something new. Whenever it comes, decide a small thing about it.
cells.core:
The direction is set, you are following it, and somewhere along the way the steering went quiet. Choices keep getting made in your name — the plan advances, things get dropped, a path narrows — and asked about it, you would say that is just how it went. What you are is showing, or has stopped showing, and you have not noticed which.

Come back to what is entering now. Something arriving today — a message, a change, a small unwanted fact — meet it as new rather than as continuation. Then make one small decision about it. That is the whole act. It puts the pen back in the hand that was already writing.

attempts.check: The record supports a capacity to direct attention and choose direction that may be running ahead, behind, or unnoticed — but it does not license me to say what the person's choices have produced, what others see when they shine, or what they have been through. The reader could reasonably say 'I am not hiding my light, I am just tired' or 'I am not overreaching, this is just how I work'. The asks survive being wrong because each is a small, optional experiment on their own attention that teaches something either way. The sentence that serves me more than them is the one that wants to name what they are — radiance, light, source — so I will keep every cell on what they do with their focus, not what they are.

attempts.check: The record supports a capacity to direct attention and choose direction that may be running ahead of its moment, behind it, or not noticed at all — but it does not license me to say what the person's choices have produced, what others see when they shine, or what they have lived through. The reader could reasonably say 'I am not hiding anything, I am just tired' or 'this is not overreach, this is how I work.' Each ask is a small, optional experiment on the person's own attention that teaches something whether or not my read is right. The sentence that serves me more than them is the one that wants to name what they are — light, source, radiance — so every cell stays on what they do with their focus, not what they are. The quartet's four asks open on four different verbs — set, hold, decide, watch — and only one is a bounded single thing.
